title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
layout_note: Two horizontal rows separated by a thin grey rule, one per LLM type (decoder-based top, encoder-decoder-based bottom). Each row starts with a grey text label card, then the same input photo, frozen Image Encoder, Q-Former with learned-query rows, Fully Connected box; only the right end differs (one LLM Decoder bar vs an LLM Encoder and LLM Decoder pair with prefix/suffix text).
grouping: Rows are separated only by a thin horizontal rule; each row has a light-grey label card at its left edge naming the variant with the LLM type in bold; within a row, modules are spaced evenly with no containers.
shapes_depth: Flat: the frozen Image Encoder is a solid blue trapezoid and the LLM parts solid blue rounded bars, each with a white snowflake; Q-Former and Fully Connected are pale-yellow rounded boxes with thin outlines. Learned queries are rows of small coloured squares (red, yellow, green, blue with an ellipsis) inside rounded trays. The input photo is overlaid with a white 3x3 grid to suggest patches.
proposed_highlight: The trainable Q-Former and Fully Connected projection are pale yellow and identical in both rows, frozen encoders and LLMs blue with snowflakes; the variant names in the left label cards are bold.
lesson: To show one adapter plugging into two kinds of backbone, repeat the identical row twice under a thin rule and let only the right-hand end differ, with a grey label card at each row's left naming the variant.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2301.12597); no venue on the first page of v3; remembered venue ICML 2023 (not verified in this session). Fig. 2 (first-stage Q-Former objectives) is already carded as blip-2-2023-fig2; this is the second-stage figure.

arrangement.units: two horizontal rows, one per LLM variant, separated by a thin grey rule and labelled by a grey card at the left
arrangement.inputs_as: the same real photo (a cat in sunglasses with a patch grid) in each row; text as quoted italic pills ('a cat', 'wearing sunglasses')
arrangement.losses_at: no loss box; the target text sits as a labelled quoted pill above the LLM decoder at each row's right end
arrangement.shared: the Image Encoder, Q-Former and Fully Connected are drawn as identical copies in both rows

taxonomy.task: vision-to-language generative pretraining with a frozen LLM

insights.structure: Two identical left-to-right rows stacked under a thin rule, one per LLM type, so the Image Encoder, Q-Former and Fully Connected line up in the same columns and only the LLM end differs.
insights.data: The input is a real photo with a white patch grid, learned queries are rows of four coloured squares in rounded trays above and below the Q-Former, and text is shown as quoted italic pills labelled Output, Prefix and Suffix Text.
insights.emphasis: Frozen blocks are saturated blue with white snowflakes and the trainable Q-Former and projection pale yellow, so the small trainable bridge reads at a glance between large frozen parts.
insights.flow: Straight arrows run left to right through each row, and a curved arrow carries the projected query row down under the LLM bar before turning up into it.
insights.avoid: The grey variant-label cards at the far left take as much width as the image, which pushes the whole pipeline right; a short row title would save space.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
